_comment: Paperclip agent definitions for the zero-rtt-lab company, one per Hermes profile.
Apply via the Paperclip UI or API after registering the hermes_local adapter in
the server registry. See ../README.md 'Paperclip' and 'Not yet verified'.
UNVERIFIED: every adapterConfig key here comes from the hermes-paperclip-adapter
README, not from a live install. Confirm each against your running Paperclip
before trusting it — an unrecognised key is silently ignored, so a budget or
toolset limit that does not exist reads exactly like one that does.
Division of authority: Paperclip owns WHAT work is assigned and WHAT it may
spend. The Hermes SOUL owns HOW the agent behaves. Do not restate SOUL rules
here — where the two disagree, the SOUL is the one that actually runs.

company.name: zero-rtt-lab
company.goal: Measure and improve 0-RTT TCP handshake elimination on the AWS 4-VM stack

agents.name: Experiment Runner
agents._owns: Dispatching and watching run-experiment.yml. Starts paid EC2 runs — the only agent that can.
_notes: timeoutSec exceeds max_watch_minutes (60) in the Hermes config so the
adapter does not kill a legitimate long poll before the agent gives up
No 'web' toolset: this agent has no reason to browse, and dropping it
removes a prompt-injection surface on the one agent that can spend money.
BUDGET: set the per-agent token ceiling here. This is the only hard spend
limit in the design — the SOUL's confirm-above-N rule is advisory.

agents.name: Experiment Analyst
agents._owns: Reading committed bundles under experiments/ci-results/ and reporting findings. Read-only.
_notes: The one agent worth a strong model — reconciling flow counts and spotting
truncated data is the whole reason the fleet exists.
Higher maxIterations: analysis walks many files in one bundle.
No 'web' toolset, and its GitHub PAT is contents:read only, so it
structurally cannot dispatch a run no matter what a task tells it.

agents.name: Experiment Warden
agents._owns: Cost watch and fleet liveness. Dispatches aws-ops.yml action=status only. Destroys nothing.
_notes: Highest-frequency agent in the fleet (every 3h) — lowest maxIterations,
shortest timeout, cheapest model. A loop here is the most expensive
Its OpenRouter fallback is LOAD-BEARING: this agent exists to break
silence about a running stack, so it must degrade rather than die.
It must never be assigned a task that implies teardown. Destroy authority
is the user's, and no issue in Paperclip should say otherwise.
